digest.component_or_area: metrics analyzer toolchain and local dev environment
propositions: The dev extra in pyproject.toml already transitively pulls lizard via the metrics extra, but this dependency is incidental to CI testing rather than explicitly stated as a dev-env requirement.

Makefile install and install-unlocked targets must explicitly name the metrics extra to pin the dev-env intent independently and prevent silent regression if the CI-motivated self-reference is ever removed.
The non-Python analyzers scc (Go) and jscpd (Node) cannot be installed via Python extras and must be documented as optional install steps in local-dev-env.md using native package managers.

Absence of scc or jscpd should degrade gracefully to Unavailable in rebar metrics output rather than causing hard failures, since the analyzers are optional and not part of the core build/lint/typecheck paths.
